source.cite: V. Ghante, L. M. Lam, S. Morris, S.-H. Yang, A. F. Tasch, D. Kamenitsa, J. Sheng, C. Magee, MRS Symp. Proc. 396, 715 (1995), DOI 10.1557/PROC-396-715
source.accuracy: SIMS: concentration better than 50 %, depth better than 10 % (the paper)
source.reading: traced by the lead (tools/digitise/tracer.py, slope continuity), every trace checked on an overlay; 400 dpi scan
source.notes: Figure 2: below about 5e17 cm^-3 the curves of 1e14 to 8e15 merge into one tail; the 1e14 trace is used for that common tail of 5e14, 2e15, 8e15.
source.fit: least squares in log10 C over the points at or above floor_cm3 and deeper than 5 nm; the form of Suzuki's n_c alone (a joined half Gaussian with the tail exp(-((x - Rpm)/L)^alpha) beyond Rpm + dRp2, kappa-joined), normalised on [0, inf); bounds Rpm 3-500 nm, dRp 2-300 nm, L 5-1000 nm, alpha 0.3-3; best of 12 starts (A21.8)

curves.label: 0 deg curve (the outer edge of the bundle, where the 0 deg label points)
